Why does this question need half an hour of talk? The answer is obviously yes, iot is basically a bunch of sensors uploading to the cloud.

From a practical perspective it makes sense to know a lot about energy usage when you have to generate electricity on demand. Too little and you have a blackout or brown out, too much and you waste a lot of money on resources, man hours, avoidable maintenance as well as potentially inaccurate billing but from a realistic perspective we both know this personal usage data will be archived by 5-6 government organizations as part of a surveillance system or two..
